summary: SES S.A., a Luxembourg-based satellite operator, filed a Form 6-K with its H1 2026 interim financial statements and a press release reporting results. The filing covers revenue of €1,602 million, adjusted EBITDA of €725 million, and reiteration of its full-year outlook. It also notes shareholder approval of a ~6% treasury share cancellation, reducing shares to 417 million, and expected O3b mPOWER satellite launches. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The treasury share cancellation is minor and not a capital return program. Therefore, the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
